status: Native static evidence plus first real Unity 2022.3.28f1 normal-gameplay focused run: 6/7 passed. gm609 passed actual4/4; gm622 failed actual0/2 despite all recorded player placements succeeding. No proxy-based completion substitution is allowed.

previewGate.operation: same two-byte clear before mode1 reload
write 0x0101 to static+0x15: both flags true
if chequearFuentes=false return; no victory predicate is evaluated

counter.ordering: Counter increment precedes mode0/mode1 actor filter. The native preview may retain real count even if its actors are excluded. Recovery filtered-network 0/0 is a diagnostic, not proof original required count was zero.
counter.predicate: st!='9' and ((name contains Cu and one of CubaFuente/CuFuente/CubFuente) or name contains BloqueChorro1)
counter.nameResolution: sq compact tokens resolve through original prefab array before native name predicates; static validator resolves same canonical aliases. Counting raw sq strings would incorrectly miss hundreds of genuine targets.

victory.timing: Periodic polling: counter resets to1 after an unsuccessful poll, not an explicit consecutive-wet requirement.
victory.previewConclusion: Disabled chequearFuentes is the native barrier against preview winning. Do not reclassify st9 preview proxies as real gameplay targets.

rCode.playerMode: Player physical landing first uses native guide at plateY+1.2. Resorte.Update invokes doBajarPieza after tiempo1=.2, which directly sets actorY=plateY. Thus ordinary recorded Save1 final positions remain gridY after compression; Total preview uses +1.2 because the simulation is disabled.
rCode.recommendedTotalPreviewPatch: Only Solve Total preview adds1.2 for r; keep normal recorded-step endpoints at compressed gridY. Production native drag commit preserves physical uncompressed guideY, then native delayed Resorte.doBajarPieza performs compression separately.

validation.mutations: Public production TryMove only; no direct actor transform, no water/switch setter, no Solve/Hint. Native waits for z/w. Report real active/required, mission flags and completion.

limitations: The validator is not a screen-input test; picking and drag trajectories have independent interaction validation.
A failure after a genuine TryMove or actual spring wait remains a restoration failure to investigate; it must not be repaired by teleporting spring actors or overriding water.
